definitions.gloss: Chinese-style noodles; ramen noodles; alkaline wheat noodles
definitions.explanation: Wheat noodles made with kansui (alkaline mineral water), giving them their characteristic yellow color, springy texture, and distinctive flavor. The base noodle used in ramen, yakisoba, and other Chinese-influenced Japanese dishes.

examples.japanese: {中華麺|ちゅうかめん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{茹|ゆ}でる→茹でる：02324_yuderu⟧。
⟦ラーメン→ラーメン：05181_raamen⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{中華麺|ちゅうかめん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{使|つか}われる→使う：00473_tsukau⟧。
examples.english: Chinese-style noodles are used in ramen.

examples.japanese: ⟦スーパー→スーパー：01061_suupaa⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{中華麺|ちゅうかめん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{買|か}って→買う：00489_kau⟧、⟦{家|いえ}→家：00612_ie⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{焼|や}きそば→焼きそば：13405_yakisoba⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{作|つく}った→作る：00481_tsukuru⟧。
examples.english: I bought Chinese-style noodles at the supermarket and made yakisoba at home.

notes:
A compound of ⟦{中華|ちゅうか}→中華：11322_chuuka⟧ (Chinese cuisine) and ⟦{麺|めん}→麺：14644_men⟧ (noodles). These noodles are distinguished from ⟦{蕎麦|そば}→蕎麦：14329_soba⟧ (buckwheat noodles) and ⟦うどん→うどん：05182_udon⟧ (thick wheat noodles) by the use of {鹹水|かんすい} (kansui, alkaline water), which gives them a yellow tint and chewy texture.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {中華麺|ちゅうかめん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{茹|ゆ}でる→茹でる：02324_yuderu⟧: to boil Chinese noodles
- {生|なま}{中華麺|ちゅうかめん}: fresh Chinese noodles
- ⟦{乾燥|かんそう}→乾燥：00184_kansou⟧{中華麺|ちゅうかめん}: dried Chinese noodles
- {太|ふと}⟦{麺|めん}→麺：14644_men⟧/{細|ほそ}⟦{麺|めん}→麺：14644_men⟧: thick noodles / thin noodles

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦ラーメン→ラーメン：05181_raamen⟧: ramen — the most common dish made with {中華麺|ちゅうかめん}
- ⟦{焼|や}きそば→焼きそば：13405_yakisoba⟧: fried noodles — another popular dish using these noodles
- ⟦うどん→うどん：05182_udon⟧: udon — thick wheat noodles without kansui
- ⟦{蕎麦|そば}→蕎麦：14329_soba⟧: soba — buckwheat noodles
